::: {.project-hook}
The project asks a different kind of research question: **how do I represent a field honestly when the literature disagrees with itself?**
:::

## Current stage

The research question has been defined and a working draft is in development. The public page deliberately does not claim submission, acceptance, or publication. The final paper and SSRN link will replace this status only after submission.

## What I am learning

A literature review is not a list of summaries. It requires decisions about inclusion, evidence quality, competing explanations, and the boundary between what a source establishes and what I infer from it.
